nodes.label: Domain-Based Repo Structure
nodes.rationale: Shared parts live at repo root; each domain's knowledge lives in its own folder and organizes itself by purpose. No domain folder may sit at the repo root.

nodes.label: Dream and Capture Scope Rule
nodes.rationale: The dream skill and tools/capture.py only touch notes/, log/, index.md, hot.md at the root, never domain folders.

nodes.label: Raw .eml Not Committed Rule
nodes.rationale: Raw TCBS emails stay in inbox/tcbs/ and are gitignored via inbox/**/*.eml.

nodes.label: Full-Path Wikilink Convention
nodes.rationale: Internal wikilinks use the full path from repo root without .md because many files share date names; add an alias for compact display.

nodes.label: Large graph.json Diff Is Expected
nodes.rationale: graph.json is rewritten whole on every build, so do not flag it as churn.

nodes.label: graphify update . (AST-Only Code Refresh)
nodes.rationale: No API cost, but only refreshes the 3 scripts; notes stay stale until /graphify . --update, which costs LLM tokens.

nodes.label: Graphify Output Commit Rule
nodes.rationale: Commit graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, graph.html, manifest.json, cost.json; cache/ and .graphify_* are gitignored.

nodes.label: Graphify Query-First Rule
nodes.rationale: query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: Graphify Stop-Hook Auto-Update Rule
nodes.rationale: Approved by the user on 2026-11-27: the Stop hook .claude/hooks/graphify_stale.py checks freshness every turn; code-only changes trigger graphify update . automatically; note changes block the stop once and require running /graphify . --update immediately without asking, reporting token cost briefly, and not committing.

nodes.label: Note Wins Over Graph Rule
nodes.rationale: The graph may be stale, so when graph and note disagree the note wins and the mismatch is mentioned.

nodes.label: Remember X Capture Rule
nodes.rationale: Saying 'remember X' (or the typo 'remeber X') runs python tools/capture.py "X" to append a bullet to today's log.

nodes.label: Sourced-and-Dated Recommendation Convention
nodes.rationale: Recommendations are written as 'TCBS: <rec> (YYYY-MM-DD)' and kept separate from 'Quyet dinh cua minh: ...' (own decision), never mixed in one sentence.
